description: This file defines a package 'stringbuffer' that provides a thread-unsafe wide string buffer implementation using UTF-16 encoding, with pooling for efficient memory management, intended for Windows API interactions.

classes.name: WString
classes.description: A wide string buffer for UTF-16 encoded strings, supporting resizing, buffer access, and conversion to UTF-8.

methods.name: NewWString
methods.description: Creates a new WString instance with a pooled buffer.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Frees the buffer back to the pool and resets the WString.

methods.name: ResizeTo
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to at least the specified capacity, doubling size if necessary.

methods.name: Pointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first uint16 in the buffer.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Converts the UTF-16 buffer to a UTF-8 string, assuming null-termination.

methods.name: Cap
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the buffer.
